user.title: NDW Charging Point (DOT-NL)
user.description: Enter the OCPI Location ID of the Dutch public charge point to track (from NDW's national open data feed, opendata.ndw.nu - see the repository README for how to find it). One sensor will be created per charge point found at this location.

error.location_not_found: That Location ID was not found in the current NDW feed.
error.cannot_connect: Could not download or parse the NDW feed.
